title: tt config ls --json
description: The settings object (PRD §14), emitted raw by `tt config ls --json` — the camelCase `@stint/core` Settings snapshot `store.settings()` returns, every key defaulted. Unlike the other snake_case scripting shapes this dumps the core type verbatim, so the keys are camelCase. Values are as strict as `config set` writes them; a corrupt stored value reads back as the documented default (§14).

timeZone.description: 'system' (follow the OS zone at read time) or a platform-supported IANA zone (§14); core validates against Intl.supportedValuesOf('timeZone').
